claude.rationale: gap_45=1: the customer-facing product (the 919.2 MW multi-country power plants) crossed the ownership boundary in a whole-company cash-out merger, but the operational processes that ran them (management services and O&M agreements) belonged to SunEdison, not the Company; the structural summary explicitly notes the product "had historically been operated by personnel and service agreements belonging to a different corporate parent" and the asset-management (GAM) transfer was "separately tracked, not-yet-complete" at closing. gap_56=1: the operating personnel and the asset-management function (T5/T6) were being insourced from SunEdison via a still-executing GAM transfer workstream, so the people/organization running the processes had not coherently transferred with the entity. gap_mitigated=yes: the dependency was documented as bridged at closing by a time-limited Transition Services Agreement (IT, HR, tax, treasury, finance, controllership) plus the negotiated "agreed-upon services" GAM transfer workstream. T1=replace because SunEdison's controlling intent (98.2% pre-merger voting power, Class B cancelled) exited and a new Brookfield-affiliate principal was installed, with all ten directors replaced by Merger Sub's three.

gemini.rationale: The deal transferred the power plants (T4) while the operational processes (T5) and personnel (T6) historically belonged to SunEdison, creating a structural mismatch (gap_45 = 1). This gap was mitigated at closing by a Transition Services Agreement and an ongoing transfer of the asset-management function from SunEdison to the Company. There is no documented gap between T5 and T6 (gap_56 = 0) as both were historically provided by SunEdison and were being transitioned together.

grok.rationale: gap_45=1 because the structural summary and process/people tier state that the customer-facing product (the long-term contracted solar/wind plants, 919.2 MW) crossed in the whole-company merger while operations remained a pre-existing SunEdison dependency via MSAs/O&M agreements, with GAM asset-management transfer still not-yet-complete at the proxy and only bridged by a time-limited TSA—i.e., a documented product-vs-process mismatch at closing. gap_56=0 because the same evidence couples the externalized processes with SunEdison personnel under those service agreements and does not document processes transferring or being re-engineered without people/org alignment as a separate closing mismatch; continuing-employee protections further tie residual company-side T6 to the deal. gap_mitigated=yes via the documented TSA and settlement 'agreed-upon services' workstream for GAM transfer.
